factor_specs.formula: cs_zscore(-vol_60d_t1) where vol_60d_t1 = rolling 60-day return SD (t-1 ending), cs_zscore = cross-sectional z-transform per sig_date with winsor [Q2.5%, Q97.5%] + standardize. Sign alignment via mathematical negation (-vol) is part of standard cross-sectional z-transform (Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2018 QMJ pattern), NOT a Factor DB NEGATE_FACTORS macro call. Z_Score_Aligned-equivalent: raw RAWDATA daily Ret feature → standard z-transform within sleeve scope.
factor_specs.direction_alignment: POSITIVE (direct) — raw factor has positive IC (mean_IC=+0.123, ICIR=+1.088 strong). Aligned directly: high z(-vol_60d) score = expected positive alpha. KR small-cap IVOL puzzle (Ang-Hodrick-Xing-Zhang 2006 anomaly reproduces in KR small-cap sleeve).
factor_specs.lag_rule: t-1 strict. vol_60d_t1 = shift(roll_sd(Ret, 60d), n=1L). PIT C2/C9 compliant. Cross-sectional z applied per sig_date.
factor_specs.winsorization: Cross-sectional z-score with 3-std equivalent quantile clip (cs_zscore function): clip x to [Q2.5%, Q97.5%] then standardize. Note: ties cluster at clip ceiling for many small-caps with near-zero vol (stale price windows) — known small-cap data property.
factor_specs.neutralization: Liquidity filter only (20d ADV >= 2e8 KRW) + sleeve scope (small/mid = exclude top 350 by Size). No explicit sector or beta neutralization — sleeve scope is intentional (small-cap effect retain).
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Ang-Hodrick-Xing-Zhang (2006) JF — high idiosyncratic vol → LOW future returns (IVOL puzzle, contradiction to standard CAPM). Frazzini-Pedersen (2014) JFE — betting-against-beta (BAB) — leveraged constraints cause high-beta high-vol stocks to underperform. KR small-cap specific: lottery-like demand (Bali-Cakici-Whitelaw 2011 JFE) drives high-vol overpricing; LowVol contrarian alpha = mispricing correction. Hong-Lim-Stein (2000) JF — small-cap underreaction + analyst coverage gap reinforces gradual price discovery. Within KR small/mid-cap (1063 stocks/sig_date), LowVol effect = 12.3% mean rank IC, 1.088 ICIR strong.

decile_breakdown.effect_characterization: LowVol alpha concentrated in eliminating extreme high-vol tail (D1 -1.19% drag). Above median (D6+), saturation — no incremental alpha from going even lower vol.
